title: Give the Drafter a Second Chance to Guess: Parallel Reconsideration for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.05724v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference with a small drafter, whose per-guess acceptance rate determines the achievable speedup. Feature-level drafters share a design choice: every token, easy or hard, is drafted under a single forward pass. Many of the tokens the target rejects are ones the drafter is itself unsure about yet the target answers decisively. To address this, we introduce Parallel Reconsideration: guided by its own uncertainty, the drafter reconsiders its hesitant guesses with extra passes that run in parallel with the one-pass draft, adding negligible latency. A co-designed training recipe and serving-time drafting algorithm append these reconsidered guesses to the original draft tree as refined candidates. Across models and benchmarks, on average, Parallel Reconsideration improves over the baselines by 5.3% to 10.2% on acceptance length and by 3.5% to 9.2% on speedup.

translated_title: 给草稿模型第二次猜测的机会：面向投机解码的并行重审方法
translated_abstract: 投机解码利用一个小型草稿模型来加速大语言模型的推理，其每次猜测的接受率决定了可实现的加速效果。特征级草稿模型都有一个共同的设计选择：无论词元是简单还是困难，都在单次前向传播中完成草拟。目标模型拒绝的许多词元，恰恰是草稿模型自身不确定、而目标模型却能果断回答的词元。为解决这一问题，我们提出了并行重审方法：在自身不确定性的引导下，草稿模型对其犹豫的猜测进行重新考虑，额外的计算与单次前向的草稿并行运行，带来的延迟几乎可以忽略不计。协同设计的训练方案与服务时草拟算法将这些重审后的猜测作为精炼候选追加到原始草稿树中。在不同模型和基准测试上，平均而言，并行重审方法相比基线在接受长度上提升5.3%至10.2%，在加速比上提升3.5%至9.2%。
tldr: 该论文提出“并行重审”方法，让投机解码中的草稿模型在自身不确定性引导下，通过与主草稿并行运行的额外前向计算重新考虑犹豫的猜测，使接受长度平均提升5.3%至10.2%，加速比平均提升3.5%至9.2%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Parallel Reconsideration, which enables the speculative decoding drafter to re-examine its uncertain guesses via extra passes running in parallel with the one-pass draft, improving acceptance length by 5.3%–10.2% and speedup by 3.5%–9.2% on average over baselines.
